parts.name: ESP32-CAM (AI-Thinker, OV2640)
parts.notes: AITRIP 2-pack (~$17): ESP32-CAM 27 x 40.5 x 4.5 mm + OV2640 + ESP32-CAM-MB (CH340, micro-USB). Price is half the pack. Search: ESP32-CAM-MB OV2640 2 pack

parts.name: ESP32-CAM-MB USB programmer
parts.notes: Included with the ESP32-CAM line above (40 x 27 mm, micro-USB)

parts.name: 5 V 2 A USB wall adapter
parts.notes: UL certified 5V 2A single-port USB-A charger. Search: UL listed 5V 2A USB wall charger

parts.name: Micro-USB cable 3 m
parts.notes: White 10 ft USB-A to micro-USB; runs from the ceiling corner down to the outlet

parts.name: Removable mounting strips
parts.notes: Command medium refill strips, 2 per unit (one on the wall flange, one on the ceiling flange), from a 9-pack (~$5). No drilling; pull-tab removal

parts.name: 220 ohm resistor
parts.notes: Status LED series resistor, inline in heat-shrink. Search: 220 ohm resistor 1/4W

parts.name: Hook-up wire and heat-shrink
parts.notes: 2 x 60 mm of 26 AWG wire + heat-shrink for the status LED. Search: 26 AWG silicone wire kit

parts.name: M4 heat-set insert
parts.notes: search: M4 heat set insert brass

parts.name: M2.5×8 self-tapping screw for plastic
parts.notes: search: M2.5 x 8mm pan head self tapping screws for plastic

soldering_reason: The status LED and its resistor are soldered to the ESP32-CAM's GPIO13 and GND pins, because the MB board's socket covers the headers.
